text: When Liam McGee departed as president of Bank of America in August, his explanation was surprisingly straight up.
translation: 利亚姆·麦基今年八月卸任美国银行总裁时，他给出的解释直白得出人意料。

syntaxAnalysis.structureType: 主从复合句 (时间状语从句 + 主系表结构)
syntaxAnalysis.mainClause: his explanation was surprisingly straight up
subordinateClauses: 时间状语从句: When Liam McGee departed as president of Bank of America in August
syntaxAnalysis.corePattern: depart as / surprisingly straight up

text: Rather than cloaking his exit in the usual vague excuses, he came right out and said he was leaving "to pursue my goal of running a company."
translation: 他没有用惯常那种含糊的托词来掩饰自己的离去，而是直言不讳地表示，他离职是“为了实现自己经营一家公司的目标”。

syntaxAnalysis.structureType: 主从复合句 (Rather than 介词短语状语 + 并列谓语 + 宾语从句)
syntaxAnalysis.mainClause: he came right out and said (that) he was leaving...
subordinateClauses: 状语: Rather than cloaking his exit in the usual vague excuses
宾语从句: (that) he was leaving to pursue my goal of running a company
目的不定式: to pursue my goal of running a company
syntaxAnalysis.corePattern: rather than doing sth / cloak sth in excuses / come right out / pursue one's goal

text: Broadcasting his ambition was "very much my decision," McGee says.
translation: 麦基说，公开表明自己的抱负“完全是我自己的决定”。

syntaxAnalysis.structureType: 直接引语 + 插入语
syntaxAnalysis.mainClause: Broadcasting his ambition was "very much my decision"
subordinateClauses: 主语: Broadcasting his ambition (动名词短语作主语)
syntaxAnalysis.corePattern: broadcast one's ambition / be one's decision

text: Within two weeks, he was talking for the first time with the board of Hartford Financial Services Group, which named him CEO and chairman on September 29.
translation: 不到两周，他就首次与哈特福德金融服务集团董事会展开接洽，该集团于9月29日任命他为首席执行官兼董事长。

syntaxAnalysis.structureType: 复合句 (时间状语 + 主句 + 非限制性定语从句)
syntaxAnalysis.mainClause: Within two weeks, he was talking for the first time with the board of Hartford Financial Services Group
subordinateClauses: 非限制性定语从句: which named him CEO and chairman on September 29 (修饰 Hartford Financial Services Group)
syntaxAnalysis.corePattern: talk with the board / name sb CEO and chairman

text: McGee says leaving without a position lined up gave him time to reflect on what kind of company he wanted to run.
translation: 麦基说，在没有找到下家的情况下离职，让他有时间思考自己想经营什么样的公司。

syntaxAnalysis.structureType: 主从复合句 (动名词短语作主语 + 双宾语 + 宾语从句)
syntaxAnalysis.mainClause: McGee says (that) leaving without a position lined up gave him time to reflect on...
subordinateClauses: 从句主语: leaving without a position lined up (with复合结构: position + lined up)
介词宾语从句: on what kind of company he wanted to run
syntaxAnalysis.corePattern: without a position lined up / reflect on

text: It also sent a clear message to the outside world about his aspirations.
translation: 此举也向外界清楚地传达了他的抱负。

syntaxAnalysis.structureType: 简单句 (主谓宾 + 介词短语状语)
syntaxAnalysis.mainClause: It also sent a clear message to the outside world about his aspirations
syntaxAnalysis.corePattern: send a clear message to sb about sth

text: And McGee isn't alone.
translation: 而且，麦基并非个例。

syntaxAnalysis.structureType: 过渡简单句
syntaxAnalysis.mainClause: And McGee isn't alone
syntaxAnalysis.corePattern: sb isn't alone

text: In recent weeks the No.2 executives at Avon and American Express quit with the explanation that they were looking for a CEO post.
translation: 最近几周，雅芳和美国运通的二号高管相继辞职，理由都是想去谋求首席执行官的职位。

syntaxAnalysis.structureType: 主从复合句 (同位语从句)
syntaxAnalysis.mainClause: the No.2 executives at Avon and American Express quit with the explanation...
subordinateClauses: 同位语从句: that they were looking for a CEO post (解释 explanation)
syntaxAnalysis.corePattern: No.2 executive / quit with the explanation that / look for a CEO post

text: As boards scrutinize succession plans in response to shareholder pressure, executives who don't get the nod also may wish to move on.
translation: 由于董事会迫于股东压力而仔细审查继任计划，那些未获认可的高管可能也想离职另谋出路。

syntaxAnalysis.structureType: 复合句 (原因/时间状语从句 + 定语从句)
syntaxAnalysis.mainClause: executives who don't get the nod also may wish to move on
subordinateClauses: 状语从句: As boards scrutinize succession plans in response to shareholder pressure
限制性定语从句: who don't get the nod (修饰 executives)
syntaxAnalysis.corePattern: scrutinize succession plans / in response to / get the nod / move on

text: A turbulent business environment also has senior managers cautious of letting vague pronouncements cloud their reputations.
translation: 动荡的商业环境也使得高层管理者十分谨慎，不愿让含糊的声明损害自己的声誉。

syntaxAnalysis.structureType: 复杂简单句 (have + 宾语 + 形容词作宾补 + 动名词复合结构)
syntaxAnalysis.mainClause: A turbulent business environment also has senior managers cautious of letting vague pronouncements cloud their reputations
subordinateClauses: 宾语补足语: cautious of letting vague pronouncements cloud their reputations
letting复合结构: let (pronouncements) cloud (their reputations) (cloud为动词原形)
syntaxAnalysis.corePattern: have sb cautious of / let sth cloud one's reputation

text: As the first signs of recovery begin to take hold, deputy chiefs may be more willing to make the jump without a net.
translation: 随着经济复苏的最初迹象逐步显现，副手们也许更愿意在没有退路的情况下放手一搏。

syntaxAnalysis.structureType: 主从复合句 (时间状语从句 + 主系表)
syntaxAnalysis.mainClause: deputy chiefs may be more willing to make the jump without a net
subordinateClauses: 时间状语从句: As the first signs of recovery begin to take hold
syntaxAnalysis.corePattern: take hold / deputy chiefs / make the jump without a net

text: In the third quarter, CEO turnover was down 23% from a year ago as nervous boards stuck with the leaders they had, according to Liberum Research.
translation: 根据利伯姆研究公司的数据，第三季度首席执行官更替率较去年同期下降了23%，因为紧张的董事会都留用了现有的领导人。

syntaxAnalysis.structureType: 主从复合句 (原因状语从句 + 定语从句 + 插入语)
syntaxAnalysis.mainClause: CEO turnover was down 23% from a year ago
subordinateClauses: 原因状语从句: as nervous boards stuck with the leaders they had
定语从句: (that) they had (修饰 leaders)
syntaxAnalysis.corePattern: CEO turnover / stick with sb / according to

text: As the economy picks up, opportunities will abound for aspiring leaders.
translation: 随着经济好转，对有抱负的领导者来说，机会将大量涌现。

syntaxAnalysis.structureType: 主从复合句 (时间状语从句 + 主谓结构)
syntaxAnalysis.mainClause: opportunities will abound for aspiring leaders
subordinateClauses: 时间状语从句: As the economy picks up
syntaxAnalysis.corePattern: pick up / abound for sb / aspiring leaders

text: The decision to quit a senior position to look for a better one is unconventional.
translation: 辞去高级职位另谋更好去处的做法并不常见。

syntaxAnalysis.structureType: 主系表结构 (不定式作后置定语与状语)
syntaxAnalysis.mainClause: The decision is unconventional
subordinateClauses: 定语: to quit a senior position
目的状语: to look for a better one
syntaxAnalysis.corePattern: decision to do sth / unconventional

text: For years executives and headhunters have adhered to the rule that the most attractive CEO candidates are the ones who must be poached.
translation: 多年来，高管和猎头们一直遵循这样一条准则：最抢手的首席执行官人选是那些必须挖角才能挖来的人。

syntaxAnalysis.structureType: 复合句 (同位语从句 + 定语从句)
syntaxAnalysis.mainClause: For years executives and headhunters have adhered to the rule...
subordinateClauses: 同位语从句: that the most attractive CEO candidates are the ones who must be poached (解释 rule)
限制性定语从句: who must be poached (修饰 the ones)
syntaxAnalysis.corePattern: adhere to the rule / attractive candidates / be poached

text: Says Korn/Ferry senior partner Dennis Carey: "I can't think of a single search I've done where a board has not instructed me to look at sitting CEOs first."
translation: 光辉国际高级合伙人丹尼斯·凯里说：“在我做过的所有猎聘项目中，我想不出有哪一次董事会没有要求我先物色在任的首席执行官。”

syntaxAnalysis.structureType: 倒装引述句 + 双重否定定语从句
syntaxAnalysis.mainClause: Says Korn/Ferry senior partner Dennis Carey (全部倒装)
subordinateClauses: 定语从句1: (that) I've done (修饰 search)
定语从句2: where a board has not instructed me to look at sitting CEOs first (修饰 search，双重否定表肯定)
syntaxAnalysis.corePattern: cannot think of a single... where... not... / instruct sb to do sth / sitting CEOs

text: Those who jumped without a job haven't always landed in top positions quickly.
translation: 那些没有找到工作就跳槽的人，并非总能很快登上高管职位。

syntaxAnalysis.structureType: 主从复合句 (定语从句 + 部分否定)
syntaxAnalysis.mainClause: Those haven't always landed in top positions quickly
subordinateClauses: 限制性定语从句: who jumped without a job (修饰 Those)
syntaxAnalysis.corePattern: jump without a job / land in top positions / not always

text: Ellen Marram quit as chief of Tropicana a decade ago, saying she wanted to be a CEO.
translation: 十年前，艾伦·马拉姆辞去纯果乐公司总裁一职，说她想当首席执行官。

syntaxAnalysis.structureType: 简单句 + 现在分词伴随状语
syntaxAnalysis.mainClause: Ellen Marram quit as chief of Tropicana a decade ago
subordinateClauses: 伴随状语: saying she wanted to be a CEO (含宾语从句)
syntaxAnalysis.corePattern: quit as chief / say that...

text: It was a year before she became head of a tiny Internet-based commodities exchange.
translation: 过了一年，她才成为一家小型互联网商品交易所的负责人。

syntaxAnalysis.structureType: 主从复合句 (It was + 时间段 + before 从句)
syntaxAnalysis.mainClause: It was a year
subordinateClauses: 时间状语从句: before she became head of a tiny Internet-based commodities exchange
syntaxAnalysis.corePattern: It was ... before ... (过了多久才...)

text: Robert Willumstad left Citigroup in 2005 with ambitions to be a CEO.
translation: 2005年，罗伯特·威伦斯塔德怀着成为首席执行官的抱负离开了花旗集团。

syntaxAnalysis.structureType: 简单句 (主谓宾 + 介词短语状语)
syntaxAnalysis.mainClause: Robert Willumstad left Citigroup in 2005 with ambitions to be a CEO
syntaxAnalysis.corePattern: leave with ambitions to be a CEO

text: He finally took that post at a major financial institution three years later.
translation: 三年之后，他终于在一家大型金融机构谋得该职位。

syntaxAnalysis.structureType: 简单句 (主谓宾 + 介词短语状语 + 时间状语)
syntaxAnalysis.mainClause: He finally took that post at a major financial institution three years later
syntaxAnalysis.corePattern: take that post at / financial institution

text: Many recruiters say the old disgrace is fading for top performers.
translation: 许多招聘人员表示，对于表现优异的高管来说，过去那种失业的耻辱感正在消退。

syntaxAnalysis.structureType: 主从复合句 (宾语从句)
syntaxAnalysis.mainClause: Many recruiters say (that) the old disgrace is fading for top performers
subordinateClauses: 宾语从句: the old disgrace is fading for top performers
syntaxAnalysis.corePattern: old disgrace is fading / top performers

text: The financial crisis has made it more acceptable to be between jobs or to leave a bad one.
translation: 金融危机使得处于两份工作之间的空档期，或从一份糟糕的工作中抽身离开变得更容易被人接受。

syntaxAnalysis.structureType: 复杂简单句 (make + it形式宾语 + 形容词宾补 + 不定式真正宾语)
syntaxAnalysis.mainClause: The financial crisis has made it more acceptable to be between jobs or to leave a bad one
subordinateClauses: 真正宾语并列: to be between jobs or to leave a bad one
代词: one 指代 job
syntaxAnalysis.corePattern: make it more acceptable to do sth / be between jobs

text: "The traditional rule was it's safer to stay where you are, but that's been fundamentally inverted," says one headhunter.
translation: 一位猎头说：“过去的规则是待在原地更稳妥，但如今这一点已经彻底颠倒过来了。”

syntaxAnalysis.structureType: 并列复合句 (直接引语 + 并列句 + 地点状语从句)
syntaxAnalysis.mainClause: The traditional rule was (that) it's safer to stay where you are, but that's been fundamentally inverted
subordinateClauses: 表语从句: (that) it's safer to stay where you are
地点状语从句: where you are
代词: that 指代传统规则
syntaxAnalysis.corePattern: traditional rule was / stay where you are / fundamentally inverted

text: "The people who've been hurt the worst are those who've stayed too long."
translation: “受伤害最深的，恰恰是那些待得太久的人。”

syntaxAnalysis.structureType: 主从复合句 (双重定语从句结构)
syntaxAnalysis.mainClause: The people are those
subordinateClauses: 定语从句1: who've been hurt the worst (修饰 The people)
定语从句2: who've stayed too long (修饰 those)
syntaxAnalysis.corePattern: be hurt the worst / stay too long
